title: Lepki language
description: Pauwasi language spoken in Western New Guinea
extract: Lepki is a Papuan language spoken in Western New Guinea, near its relatives Murkim and Kembra in Highland Papua. Only a few hundred words have been recorded, in hastily collected word lists.
